ei.subject: 공통영어1
ei.title: Banksy's New Work in Port Talbot

fullPassage:
Secretive street artist Banksy designed another interesting piece of art, which appears on a concrete block garage in Port Talbot, Wales. It shows a child catching snowflakes with his mouth. When you look around the corner, however, you realize that the child's mouth is open to ash coming from a dumpster fire.
Banksy was asked by Gary Owen, a Port Talbot resident, to create art that would highlight Port Talbot's dust problem. Owen believed that the area's children were facing serious health risks by playing in the dust coming from the local steel plant.
Children are particularly defenseless against air pollution. Since they have faster breathing rates than adults, they breathe in more pollutants. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), about 93% of the world's children under 15 breathe in toxic air every day. In 2016, the WHO even estimated that about 600,000 children died from exposure to polluted air.
Banksy's art has included environmental messages before. For example, his 2010 artwork was created at the remains of a plant in Detroit. It showed a child with a can of red paint and the words, "I remember when all this was trees."

questions.passage: Secretive street artist Banksy designed another (A)[interesting / boring] piece of art, which appears on a concrete block garage in Port Talbot, Wales. It shows a child catching snowflakes with his mouth. When you look around the corner, however, you realize that the child's mouth is open to ash coming from a (B)[dumpster / garden] fire. Banksy was asked by Gary Owen, a Port Talbot resident, to create art that would (C)[highlight / conceal] Port Talbot's dust problem.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ (A) interesting(흥미로운) — Banksy의 작품 묘사 ←정답

✅ (B) dumpster(쓰레기통) — 쓰레기통 불에서 나오는 재 ←정답

✅ (C) highlight(부각시키다) — 분진 문제를 알리기 위한 예술 ←정답

❌ boring(지루한), garden(정원), conceal(숨기다)는 문맥 반대
det.tip: highlight(부각) ↔ conceal(숨기다), interesting(흥미로운) ↔ boring(지루한)

questions.passage: Banksy was asked by Gary Owen, a Port Talbot resident, to create art that would highlight Port Talbot's dust problem. Owen believed that the area's children were facing (A)[serious / minor] health risks by playing in the dust coming from the local steel plant. Children are particularly (B)[defenseless / resistant] against air pollution. Since they have faster breathing rates than adults, they breathe in more (C)[pollutants / nutrients]. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), about 93% of the world's children under 15 breathe in toxic air every day.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 심각한 건강 위험, 대기 오염에 무방비, 더 많은 오염물질.
det.analysis:
✅ (A) serious(심각한) — 건강 위험의 심각성 ←정답

✅ (B) defenseless(무방비의) — 아이들이 대기 오염에 취약 ←정답

✅ (C) pollutants(오염물질) — 더 많은 오염물질 흡입 ←정답

❌ minor(사소한), resistant(저항력 있는), nutrients(영양소)는 문맥 반대
det.tip: serious(심각한) ↔ minor(사소한), defenseless(무방비) ↔ resistant(저항력 있는)

questions.passage: Children are particularly defenseless against air pollution. Since they have faster breathing rates than adults, they breathe in more pollutants. According to the WHO, about 93% of the world's children under 15 breathe in (A)[toxic / fresh] air every day. In 2016, the WHO even estimated that about 600,000 children died from (B)[exposure / resistance] to polluted air. Banksy's art has included (C)[environmental / commercial] messages before.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ (A) toxic(유독한) — 93%가 유독한 공기를 마심 ←정답

✅ (B) exposure(노출) — 오염된 공기 노출로 사망 ←정답

✅ (C) environmental(환경적) — Banksy 작품의 환경 메시지 ←정답

❌ fresh(신선한), resistance(저항), commercial(상업적)는 문맥 반대
det.tip: toxic(유독한) ↔ fresh(신선한), exposure(노출) ↔ resistance(저항)

questions.passage:
Secretive street artist Banksy designed another interesting piece of art, which appears on a ①<u>concrete</u> block garage in Port Talbot, Wales. It shows a child catching ②<u>snowflakes</u> with his mouth. When you look around the corner, however, you realize that the child's mouth is open to ash coming from a dumpster fire.
Banksy was asked by Gary Owen, a Port Talbot resident, to create art that would ③<u>minimize</u> Port Talbot's dust problem. Owen believed that the area's children were facing ④<u>serious</u> health risks.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ①concrete(콘크리트) — 원문 그대로

✅ ②snowflakes(눈송이) — 원문 그대로

❌ ③minimize(최소화하다) — 원문은 highlight(부각시키다). 문제를 알리려는 맥락에서 최소화는 반대 ←정답

✅ ④serious(심각한) — 원문 그대로
det.tip: highlight(부각시키다) ↔ minimize(최소화하다). Owen이 문제를 알리려고 예술을 요청.

questions.passage: Children are particularly ①<u>defenseless</u> against air pollution. Since they have faster breathing rates than adults, they breathe in more ②<u>pollutants</u>. According to the WHO, about 93% of the world's children under 15 breathe in ③<u>toxic</u> air every day. In 2016, the WHO even estimated that about 600,000 children ④<u>recovered</u> from exposure to polluted air.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ①defenseless(무방비의) — 원문 그대로

✅ ②pollutants(오염물질) — 원문 그대로

✅ ③toxic(유독한) — 원문 그대로

❌ ④recovered(회복했다) — 원문은 died(사망했다). 오염 공기 노출의 심각한 결과로 회복은 반대 ←정답
det.tip: died(사망) ↔ recovered(회복). 600,000 children died from exposure.

questions.passage:
Secretive street artist Banksy designed another interesting piece of art. It shows a child catching snowflakes with his mouth.
Banksy was asked by Gary Owen, a Port Talbot ①<u>resident</u>, to create art that would highlight Port Talbot's dust problem. Owen believed that the area's children were facing ②<u>serious</u> health risks by playing in the dust coming from the local steel plant.
Banksy's art has included ③<u>environmental</u> messages before. For example, his 2010 artwork was created at the ④<u>summit</u> of a plant in Detroit.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ①resident(주민) — 원문 그대로

✅ ②serious(심각한) — 원문 그대로

✅ ③environmental(환경적) — 원문 그대로

❌ ④summit(정상/꼭대기) — 원문은 remains(잔해/터). 공장의 '터'에서 '정상'은 맥락 부적합 ←정답
det.tip: remains(잔해/터) ↔ summit(정상). at the remains of a plant = 공장 터에서.

questions.passage:
Secretive street artist Banksy designed another interesting piece of art, which appears on a concrete block garage in Port Talbot, Wales. It shows a child catching snowflakes with his mouth. When you look around the corner, however, you realize that the child's mouth is open to ash coming from a __________ fire.
Banksy was asked by Gary Owen, a Port Talbot resident, to create art that would highlight Port Talbot's dust problem. Owen believed that the area's children were facing serious health risks by playing in the dust coming from the local steel plant.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ①campfire(캠프파이어) — 도시 환경과 맞지 않음

✅ ②dumpster(쓰레기통) — 오염/분진 문제의 맥락에 적합 ←정답

❌ ③candle(양초) — 재가 나올 정도의 불이 아님

❌ ④chimney(굴뚝) — dumpster fire가 원문
det.tip: dumpster fire = 쓰레기통 불. 대기 오염과 연결되는 상징적 이미지.

questions.passage:
Banksy was asked by Gary Owen, a Port Talbot resident, to create art that would highlight Port Talbot's dust problem. Owen believed that the area's children were facing serious health risks by playing in the dust coming from the local __________ plant.
Children are particularly defenseless against air pollution. Since they have faster breathing rates than adults, they breathe in more pollutants. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), about 93% of the world's children under 15 breathe in toxic air every day.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ①steel(철강) — 제철 공장에서 분진이 발생하는 맥락 ←정답

❌ ②flower(꽃) — 분진/오염과 무관

❌ ③power(발전) — 분진보다는 배기가스

❌ ④water(수도) — 분진 발생과 무관
det.tip: steel plant = 제철소. 분진(dust)의 원인이 되는 산업 시설.

questions.passage:
Owen believed that the area's children were facing serious health risks by playing in the dust coming from the local steel plant.
Children are particularly defenseless against air pollution. Since they have faster breathing rates than adults, they breathe in more pollutants. According to the WHO, about 93% of the world's children under 15 breathe in __________ air every day. In 2016, the WHO even estimated that about 600,000 children died from exposure to polluted air.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ①fresh(신선한) — 오염 맥락과 반대

❌ ②clean(깨끗한) — 오염 맥락과 반대

❌ ③pure(순수한) — 오염 맥락과 반대

✅ ④toxic(유독한) — defenseless, pollutants와 이어지는 부정적 맥락 ←정답
det.tip: toxic = 유독한. defenseless → more pollutants → toxic air: 부정적 맥락 일관.

questions.passage: Secretive street artist Banksy designed another interesting piece of art, which appears on a concrete block garage in Port Talbot, Wales. It shows a child catching snowflakes with his mouth. When you look around the corner, however, you <u>realize</u> that the child's mouth is open to ash.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 realize와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ①forget(잊다) — realize의 반대 방향

❌ ②ignore(무시하다) — 인식과 반대

✅ ③recognize(인식하다/깨닫다) — realize와 동의어 ←정답

❌ ④create(만들다) — 전혀 무관
det.tip: realize = recognize = understand: 깨닫다/인식하다.

questions.passage: Banksy was asked by Gary Owen, a Port Talbot resident, to create art that would <u>highlight</u> Port Talbot's dust problem. Owen believed that the area's children were facing serious health risks.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 highlight와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ①emphasize(강조하다) — highlight와 동의어 ←정답

❌ ②diminish(줄이다) — 부각과 반대

❌ ③ignore(무시하다) — 부각과 반대

❌ ④resolve(해결하다) — 관련 있지만 '부각'과는 다름
det.tip: highlight = emphasize = draw attention to: 부각시키다/강조하다.

questions.passage:
In 2016, the WHO even <u>estimated</u> that about 600,000 children died from exposure to polluted air.
Banksy's art has included environmental messages before.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 estimated와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ①confirmed(확인했다) — 추정보다 확실한 의미

❌ ②denied(부인했다) — 추정과 반대

❌ ③demanded(요구했다) — 전혀 다른 의미

✅ ④calculated(계산/추산했다) — estimated와 유사 ←정답
det.tip: estimate = calculate approximately: 추정하다/추산하다.

questions.passage: Children are particularly <u>defenseless</u> against air pollution. Since they have faster breathing rates than adults, they breathe in more pollutants.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 defenseless와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ①vulnerable(취약한) — defenseless와 유의어

✅ ②protected(보호받는) — defenseless의 반의어 ←정답

❌ ③exposed(노출된) — defenseless와 유사

❌ ④helpless(무력한) — defenseless와 유의어
det.tip: defenseless(무방비) ↔ protected(보호받는). de-fense-less = 방어가 없는.

questions.passage: Secretive street artist Banksy designed another interesting piece of art, which appears on a concrete block garage in Port Talbot, Wales. It shows a child catching snowflakes with his mouth. Banksy was asked by Gary Owen, a Port Talbot resident, to create art that would highlight Port Talbot's dust problem. Owen believed that the area's children were facing <u>serious</u> health risks.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 serious와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ①severe(심각한) — serious와 유의어

❌ ②critical(위급한) — serious와 유사

✅ ③trivial(사소한) — serious의 반의어 ←정답

❌ ④grave(심각한) — serious와 유의어
det.tip: serious(심각한) ↔ trivial(사소한/하찮은).

questions.passage:
(A) It shows a child catching snowflakes with his mouth. When you look around the <u>corner</u>, however, you realize the truth.
(B) The store is located at the <u>corner</u> of Main Street and Oak Avenue.
questions.stem: 다음 두 문장의 밑줄 친 corner의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) 모퉁이: 작품의 모퉁이를 돌면 (B) 교차 지점: 두 거리가 만나는 곳.
det.analysis:
✅ (A) corner = 모퉁이 (건물/벽의 모퉁이를 돌아가면)
✅ (B) corner = 교차 지점 (두 거리가 만나는 코너)

❌ ①②③ 의미 조합이 부정확
✅ ④모퉁이—교차 지점 ←정답
det.tip: corner: (A) 건물 모퉁이 (B) 거리 교차점. 물리적 위치의 다른 맥락.

questions.stem:
다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
"the state of being in contact with something harmful"

det.analysis:
✅ ①exposure(노출) — 해로운 것과의 접촉 상태 ←정답

❌ ②protection(보호) — 접촉을 막는 것

❌ ③resistance(저항) — 접촉에 맞서는 것

❌ ④avoidance(회피) — 접촉을 피하는 것
det.tip: exposure = 노출. exposure to polluted air = 오염된 공기에 대한 노출.

questions.passage: Air __________ is a major concern for children's health worldwide. (pollute)
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.analysis: ✅ pollution: Air + __________ → 명사 필요. pollute(동사) → pollution(명사).
det.tip: pollute(동사: 오염시키다) → pollution(명사: 오염). -tion 접미사.

questions.passage: Children are __________ defenseless against air pollution. (particular)
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.analysis: ✅ particularly: are + __________ + defenseless → 부사 필요. particular(형용사) → particularly(부사).
det.tip: particular(형용사: 특정한) → particularly(부사: 특히). 형용사 defenseless를 수식.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:

✅ ②serious health risks(심각한 건강 위험) — 분진 속에서 노는 아이들의 위험 ←정답

❌ ③great opportunities(큰 기회) — 건강 위험과 무관

det.tip: serious health risks = 심각한 건강 위험. facing = 직면하다.

questions.passage: Banksy's art has included environmental messages before. For example, his 2010 artwork was created at __________ in Detroit. It showed a child with a can of red paint and the words, "I remember when all this was trees."
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 디트로이트의 한 공장 터(the remains of a plant)에서.
det.analysis:
❌ ①the center of a museum(박물관 중앙) — Banksy는 거리 예술가

❌ ②the top of a building(건물 꼭대기) — 공장 터와 무관

✅ ③the remains of a plant(공장 터/잔해) — 'all this was trees' → 자연 파괴된 공장 터 ←정답

det.tip: remains of a plant = 공장의 잔해/터. plant = 공장(factory), 나무(tree) 다의어.
